purpose: Provenance and licence status for every external asset fetched into this working tree during the encoder sweep. The assets themselves live under data/ and data/gpu-models/, which are git-ignored, so without this file the repository does not record what was downloaded or under what terms.
warning: Several assets below are NON-COMMERCIAL. Nothing derived from them may ship in a commercial product. Every 'licence_verified' value of false means the terms were not confirmed from the publisher and must be checked before any use.

external_datasets.name: LUMOS
external_datasets.commercial_use: PROHIBITED without prior written permission from the host ethics committee
external_datasets.contents: 8 DICOM archives, 4838 lumbar radiographs, 803 patients; clinical table with DXA-measured L1-L4 BMD, BMC, T-score and Z-score per patient
external_datasets.prepared: data/external/lumos-prep, 1614 images at 256px uint8, one view per patient-region
external_datasets.used_for: two pretext tasks, both measured and rejected; see docs/competition/foundation_encoders_2026_10_04.json
external_datasets.outcome: Density regression val R2 -0.029; masked reconstruction probe balanced accuracy 0.356 against a 0.391 majority baseline, failing its pre-registered acceptance test. No feature from it was transferred.
external_datasets.residual_obligation: None. No weights, features or derived artefacts from LUMOS were kept.

external_datasets.name: NHANES 2011/2015/2017 DXA
external_datasets.licence: US federal government work, public domain
external_datasets.outcome: Produced the prevalence comparison: objects 1.04%, insufficient scan area 0.07%, movement 0.09% per vertebra, against 17.2/6.1/24.0 percent in this cohort.
external_datasets.note: NHANES publishes no DXA images, so this can never be a training-pixel source.

external_datasets.name: SpineWeb / AASCE curated annotations
external_datasets.contents: corrected vertebra-corner annotations for 609 AP spine radiographs plus the per-case correction table
external_datasets.note: Annotations only. The original image host spineweb.digitalimaginggroup.ca is offline. The correction table documents swapped vertebral levels and flipped corners in the original labels, which is itself evidence that expert keypoint labelling at this scale is error-prone.

external_datasets.name: HipRay
external_datasets.contents: 140 lower-limb and hip radiographs with 3-class segmentation masks, NIfTI
external_datasets.note: Already committed to the repository before this sweep. Plain radiography, not DXA, and only 140 images.

model_weights.name: google/medsiglip-448
model_weights.licence: HLS terms (Health AI Developer Foundation); the model card reports 'other'
model_weights.commercial_use: RESTRICTED - check the HLS terms before any use
model_weights.outcome: 0.5714 overall F1, worse than the geometry baseline

model_weights.name: DINOv3 ViT-L/16 lvd1689m via the PIA-SPACE-LAB mirror
model_weights.licence: DINOv3 licence; the upstream repository is gated manual so the licence text could NOT be read from the publisher
model_weights.commercial_use: UNKNOWN - treat as restricted until the DINOv3 licence is read directly
model_weights.gated: upstream gated manual; access request was REJECTED by the repository authors on 2026-10-04
model_weights.provenance: Unofficial ungated mirror. Accepted only after 366 of 366 tensors matched timm/vit_large_patch16_dinov3.lvd1689m bitwise, including cls_token, register_tokens, patch embeddings, all 24 blocks of attention, layer scales, norms and MLP.
model_weights.rejected_alternative: rA9del/dinov3b16 matched no checked tensor and had a wrong feed-forward shape (SwiGLU hidden 2048 instead of MLP 3072). Deleted without use.
model_weights.outcome: best single frozen encoder at 0.6111 F1 on one seed, 0.5896 mean over four

model_weights.name: microsoft/rad-dino
model_weights.licence: MIT per the model card text; the repository API reports no licence tag
model_weights.digest_cross_check: matches the RAD-DINO checkpoint already pinned in docs/competition/dxa_spine_vit_raddino_cv_2026_09_28.json
model_weights.outcome: 0.4969 overall F1, worse than the geometry baseline

model_weights.name: StanfordAIMI/dinov2-base-xray-224
model_weights.provenance: Undocumented community mirror with no second redistribution available to cross-check, so trust rests on the repository alone.
model_weights.outcome: 0.4972 overall F1, worse than the geometry baseline

model_weights.name: chaofengc/IQA-PyTorch-Weights
model_weights.location: downloaded on demand by pyiqa into the user cache
model_weights.used_for: seven frozen no-reference IQA scores: brisque, niqe, piqe, musiq, maniqa, topiq_nr, clipiqa
model_weights.outcome: 0.4490 overall F1, the worst of every family tried. These read noise, contrast and sharpness and are blind to rotation, laterality and coverage, which is four of the six criteria.

not_downloaded.why_it_matters: The only ungated source of real DXA pixels at scale: 5209 hip, 4632 AP lumbar, 4325 lateral lumbar. Carries no positioning labels, so it cannot teach defect detection, but it is the only route to scale for the rare criteria.

not_downloaded.blocked_by: application, fee and months of latency
not_downloaded.why_it_matters: enCORE ROI overlays are burned into the pixels, giving coverage supervision free on tens of thousands of DXA scans.
12,040 DXA scans with scoliosis angle in degrees, i.e. the closest published analogue to spine_axis.

credentials.note: A HuggingFace token was used to fetch gated weights. It was written to ~/.cache/huggingface/token with mode 600 and is not present anywhere in this repository. It was exposed in chat history on 2026-10-04 and should be rotated.

blocking_for_commercial_release: LUMOS is CC BY-NC 4.0. Nothing derived from it may ship commercially. No artefact was kept, so the obligation is currently discharged, but the dataset must not be reintroduced into a commercial build.
MedSigLIP-448 carries HLS terms that restrict use and were not verified here.
The DINOv3 licence could not be read because the upstream repository is gated; treat the mirrored weights as restricted.
pyiqa weights are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. The computed IQA scores are in data/ only and were not retained.
permitted: RAD-DINO if its MIT claim holds.

kaggle_chinese_dxa_corpus.name: Kaggle Chinese osteoporosis DXA corpus
kaggle_chinese_dxa_corpus.licence: CC BY 4.0 (verified via Kaggle API licenseName: 'Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)')
kaggle_chinese_dxa_corpus.verdict: Acquired, integrity-checked, and found unusable for metric work.
kaggle_chinese_dxa_corpus.why: No positioning annotations. The clinical workbook (2186 rows) keys on Serial Number only, which is a row index, not a patient identifier, so it cannot be joined to the 2289 patients in the filenames. With no join there is no honest way to measure whether the corpus helps, since the only available measurement is the held-out competition folds. Framing also differs: 47 percent pure black pixels in the competition frames against 0.17 percent here, mean intensity 46 against 143, and the hip subset carries burned-in device text.
